dedupe_keys.name: fi tw finland integrated train weather dataset for railway delay analysis

description: FI-TW combines Finnish railway operations with synchronised weather observations for delay research. Each record is a timetable event (arrival or departure) of a long-distance train at a station, joined to the observations of the nearest Finnish Meteorological Institute weather station at that time; the paper describes operational data from Fintraffic's Digitraffic railway service matched to 209 stations across the 5,915 km network, with engineered features, missing-data handling by spatial fallback and scaling of outliers, and a baseline delay prediction model. Coverage is national (Finland), from 2018, with about 48 million records and up to 125 columns in the Kaggle release covering 2018 to 2025. The data are free to download from Kaggle as Apache Parquet files (about 2.7 GB) under the GPL 3 licence stated there; the preprint is on arXiv (version 2, August 2026). Caveats: it covers long-distance trains, weather comes from the closest station, not on-track conditions, and the licence is a software licence applied to data. It supports weather-related delay prediction, vulnerability mapping of rail corridors to cold, snow and wind, and resilience analysis of rail operations. It is derived from Digitraffic and complements the DLR trajectory datasets for road.
